newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda aims for Thai car sales of 55,000 in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Honda aims for Thai car sales of 55,000 in 1997.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Tuesday it aims to boost car sales in Thailand by 30 percent this year to 55,000 vehicles from last year's 42,500.
A Honda spokesman said it plans to introduce the 1500 cc City passenger car in Thailand by mid-1997.

Honda's local joint venture, Honda Cars Thailand Co, markets the City, Civic and Accord passenger cars manufactured in Thailand as well as the CR-V sport-utility vehicle, which is imported from Japan, the spokesman said.
The company also plans to start exporting several hundred cars annually from its factory in Thailand to neighbouring countries in the latter half of 1997, the spokesman said.
